BiblicalUsage: bûwz covers disrespect, contempt, and the Bible uses it the way ordinary people would. You find it 11 times, in Genesis among other places, and each time it is doing the same steady work. It is a word you understand best by watching where it goes, not by guessing at it.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: disrespect, contempt is part of how God speaks to us, and bûwz is the word He chose for it. That is reason enough to learn it.
